summary: In the frozen development multi run, the main agent inspected the same implementation and test ranges before delegating those exact ranges for source reproduction. The original fixed verifier subsequently failed; resource convergence and 34 original request snapshots were independently rechecked.

The delegated role had only repeated existing source, not checked a distinct uncertainty or negative behavior.
